verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs include a codebase-understanding guide titled "Trace how a repo fits together and find the right places to start", and Cloud Agents can "inspect the full workspace", so the product does document repo-level comprehension. The evidence is only a one-line heading, with no detail on how the agent gathers context on its own. missing for 10: documented automatic codebase indexing/semantic search, explicit evidence that no manual context-file selection is needed, depth on whole-codebase mapping/explanation output, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent map and explain an entire unfamiliar codebase without manually selecting context files

citations.quote: Trace how a repo fits together and find the right places to start
inspect the full workspace, make coordinated changes, and open pull requests in the repos it changes
